accessToken.label: Access Token
accessToken.description: An OAuth access token of your Zoho CRM account, such as one from a Self Client in the Zoho API Console (https://api-console.zoho.com) with the scopes ZohoCRM.users.ALL, ZohoCRM.org.ALL, ZohoCRM.settings.ALL, ZohoCRM.modules.ALL, ZohoCRM.bulk.ALL, ZohoCRM.bulk.backup.ALL and ZohoFiles.files.ALL.

apiDomain.label: API Domain
apiDomain.description: The api_domain Zoho gives with the token, for your account's location, such as https://www.zohoapis.com, https://www.zohoapis.eu, https://www.zohoapis.in, https://www.zohoapis.com.au, https://www.zohoapis.jp or https://www.zohoapis.ca.

create_record.label: Create Record
create_record.description: Creates a record in any module, including custom fields.

module.label: Module
module.description: The Zoho CRM module (for example Leads, Contacts, Deals or a custom module).

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Standard and custom fields of the module, as a JSON object of field API names and values. Read-only, formula, subform and file fields are not listed.

additional_fields.label: Additional Fields (JSON)
additional_fields.description: Optional raw fields by API name, for fields the form does not list (e.g. subform rows). Values set in the form above win over the same key here.

triggers.label: Automation to Run
triggers.description: Empty runs Zoho's default workflows; pick some to run only those: workflow, approval, blueprint, pathfinder, orchestration, as a JSON list.

skip_automation.label: Skip All Automation
skip_automation.description: Run no workflow, approval or blueprint for this record.

update_record.label: Update Record
update_record.description: Updates fields of a record in any module. Fields left empty are not changed.

module.label: Module
module.description: The Zoho CRM module (for example Leads, Contacts, Deals or a custom module).

record_id.label: Record
record_id.description: Pick one of the 200 most recently modified records, or map a record id from an earlier step.

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Only the fields you fill in are changed. Use "Clear Fields" to blank a field.

clear_fields.label: Clear Fields
clear_fields.description: Field API names to set to empty (e.g. "Phone", "Custom_Field__c").

additional_fields.label: Additional Fields (JSON)
additional_fields.description: Optional raw fields by API name, for fields the form does not list (e.g. subform rows). Values set in the form above win over the same key here.

skip_automation.label: Skip All Automation
skip_automation.description: Run no workflow, approval or blueprint for this update.

upsert_record.label: Create or Update Record
upsert_record.description: Updates the record that matches on the duplicate-check fields, or creates it if none matches.

module.label: Module
module.description: The Zoho CRM module (for example Leads, Contacts, Deals or a custom module).

duplicate_check_fields.label: Duplicate Check Fields
duplicate_check_fields.description: Fields used to find an existing record, as a JSON list. Leave empty to use Zoho's default (Email for Leads/Contacts, Account_Name for Accounts, Deal_Name for Deals, Name for custom modules).

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Standard and custom fields of the module, as a JSON object of field API names and values.

additional_fields.label: Additional Fields (JSON)
additional_fields.description: Optional raw fields by API name, for fields the form does not list (e.g. subform rows). Values set in the form above win over the same key here.

delete_record.label: Delete Record
delete_record.description: Deletes a record (it moves to the Zoho CRM Recycle Bin).

module.label: Module
module.description: The Zoho CRM module (for example Leads, Contacts, Deals or a custom module).

record_id.label: Record
record_id.description: Pick one of the 200 most recently modified records, or map a record id from an earlier step.

run_workflows.label: Run Workflows
run_workflows.description: Run delete workflows configured in Zoho (Zoho default: on).

convert_lead.label: Convert Lead
convert_lead.description: Converts a lead into a contact and account, and optionally a deal.

lead_id.label: Lead
lead_id.description: Pick one of the 200 most recently modified records, or map a record id from an earlier step.

account_id.label: Existing Account
account_id.description: Link to this account; the lead's Company must match its name.

contact_id.label: Existing Contact
contact_id.description: Merge into this contact; the lead's name and email must match.

overwrite.label: Overwrite Contact's Account
overwrite.description: Move the existing contact to the given account.

assign_to.label: Owner
assign_to.description: Active user who owns the new records; empty keeps the lead owner.

deal_stage.label: Deal Stage
deal_stage.description: A Stage picklist value of your org, e.g. "Qualification".

deal_pipeline.label: Deal Pipeline
deal_pipeline.description: Required when your org uses pipelines, e.g. "Standard (Standard)".

add_note.label: Add Note
add_note.description: Adds a note to a record.

module.label: Module
module.description: The Zoho CRM module (for example Leads, Contacts, Deals or a custom module).

record_id.label: Record
record_id.description: Pick one of the 200 most recently modified records, or map a record id from an earlier step.

add_tags_to_record.label: Add Tags to Record
add_tags_to_record.description: Adds existing or new tags to a record. New tag names are created first.

module.label: Module
module.description: The Zoho CRM module (for example Leads, Contacts, Deals or a custom module).

record_id.label: Record
record_id.description: Pick one of the 200 most recently modified records, or map a record id from an earlier step.

tags.label: Existing Tags
tags.description: Tags already defined for the module, as a JSON list of names.

new_tags.label: New Tag Names
new_tags.description: Tag names to create (if missing) and add, as a JSON list.

zoho_crm_list_modules.label: List Modules
zoho_crm_list_modules.description: Lists the modules available through the API.

zoho_crm_get_module_fields.label: Get Module Fields
zoho_crm_get_module_fields.description: Lists the fields of a module, custom fields included.

module_api_name.label: Module API Name
module_api_name.description: Module API name from List Modules, e.g. "Leads", "Contacts", "Deals", "Accounts" or "CustomModule1". Not the display label.

include_read_only.label: Include Read-Only Fields
include_read_only.description: Also list fields that cannot be written (formula, system, auto-number).

zoho_crm_get_related_lists.label: Get Related Lists
zoho_crm_get_related_lists.description: Lists the related lists of a module.

module_api_name.label: Module API Name
module_api_name.description: Module API name from List Modules, e.g. "Leads", "Contacts", "Deals", "Accounts" or "CustomModule1". Not the display label.

zoho_crm_list_users.label: List Users

zoho_crm_get_user.label: Get User
zoho_crm_get_user.description: Gets a CRM user by id.

zoho_crm_get_current_user.label: Get Current User

zoho_crm_list_records.label: List Records
zoho_crm_list_records.description: Lists records of a module, one page at a time.

module_api_name.description: Module API name from List Modules, e.g. "Leads", "Contacts", "Deals" or "CustomModule1".

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Field API names to return (max 50), as a JSON list. Leave empty for id, then the custom fields of the module, then its standard fields (50 in total).

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number for the first 2,000 records. Do not combine with page_token.

page_token.label: Page Token
page_token.description: next_page_token from a previous call, needed beyond 2,000 records.

custom_view_id.label: Custom View ID
custom_view_id.description: Optional id of a custom view (cvid) to list only its records.

fields.description: Optional field API names to return, as a JSON list; empty returns all fields.

zoho_crm_create_lead.label: Create Lead

lead_source.label: Lead Source
lead_source.description: A Lead_Source picklist value of your org, e.g. "Web Download".

lead_status.label: Lead Status
lead_status.description: A Lead_Status picklist value of your org, e.g. "Not Contacted".

owner_id.label: Owner User ID
owner_id.description: Optional user id (from List Users or Get Current User). Default: the connected user.

additional_fields.label: Additional Fields
additional_fields.description: Optional JSON of other field API names, including custom fields, e.g. {"Custom_Field__c": "x"}. The named props above win over the same key here.

zoho_crm_create_deal.label: Create Deal

stage.label: Stage

closing_date.label: Closing Date

pipeline.label: Pipeline

additional_fields.label: Additional Fields
additional_fields.description: Optional JSON of other field API names, including custom fields, e.g. {"Custom_Field__c": "x"}. The named props above win over the same key here.

zoho_crm_list_notes.label: List Notes
zoho_crm_list_notes.description: Lists notes of a record, or all notes.

module.label: Parent Module
module.description: Module API name of the record, e.g. "Leads". Give with parent_id.

note_id.label: Note ID

record_ids.label: Record IDs
